plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Agricultural Leadership and Development (BS). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Select from AGCJ 100-499; AGEC 117-499; AGLS 100-499; AGSM 100-499; ANSC 100-499; BAEN 100-499; BESC 100-499; BICH 100-499; DASC 100-499; ECCB 100-499; ENTO 100-499; FIVS 100-499; FSTC 100-499; GENE 100-499; HMGT 100-499; HORT 100-499; NUTR 100-499; PLPA 100-499; POSC 100-499; RWFM 100-499; SCSC 100-499.
[grid1 fn2] ALED courses may not be used for these electives.
[grid1 fn3] Select course not taken the previous semester.
[grid1 fn4] Select from ALEC 300-499; ALED 300-499.
